mentions.name: Songformat
mentions.description: A text-based song format for generating music. Songs are written entirely in text using a TOML-based format that includes most features found in a DAW. The format can be described in a SKILL file so AI can write songs in it, which can then be converted to audio.
mentions.problem: The author wanted to be able to create a song entirely using text.
mentions.source_excerpt: A text-based song format for generating music. I wanted to be able to create a song entirely using text, so I created a TOML-based format for doing so, and gave it most of the features you would find in a DAW. Since the format can be described in a SKILL file, AI can be used to write a song in this format, which can then be converted to audio.
mentions.author: meltmymind
